description: Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment - Notify the Air Emission, Fuel and Vehicle Importation Standards under the National Environment Act
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the National Environmental Act, specifically amending vehicle emission standards and importation requirements. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for environmental compliance, vehicle testing, and certification procedures, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions the President, it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on creating and modifying regulatory requirements.
